title: Leads, Sales or Views: What’s most important in Meta Ads?
description: Leads, Sales or Views: What’s most important in Meta Ads?
transcript: What's the best optimization? Leads, landing page views or sales? Definitely not landing page views. And then between the other two, it really depends on your business. So you want to go with sales if you can track the purchase conversion when someone actually makes a purchase. Uh, particularly if there are differing values, and you can optimize for higher value purchases. People who spend more when they buy from your ecommerce store, for example. If you can't track that directly, as in there's an intermediary step, people book a free quote or a call or a consultation or something like that, then you're better off going with leads.
